The main takeaway from our work is that

neural representations of the world that disentangle 3D objects from their backgrounds and reflect the 3D geometry of the world, can be learned from RGB-D images in an end-to-end self- supervised fashion, and can be used to generalize few-shot to novel objects and scenes.
